description: This file implements a streaming interface for interacting with the Ollama API, including URL resolution, request building, response parsing, and stream management for chat messages and tool calls.

methods.name: resolveOllamaBaseUrlForRun
methods.description: Resolves the base URL for Ollama API calls based on provided model and provider URLs, defaulting to a native URL.

methods.name: isOllamaCompatProvider
methods.description: Checks if a given model provider is compatible with Ollama, based on provider ID and URL hostname/port/path.

methods.name: resolveOllamaCompatNumCtxEnabled
methods.description: Determines if the number of context tokens should be injected for OpenAI compatibility based on provider config.

methods.name: shouldInjectOllamaCompatNumCtx
methods.description: Decides whether to inject the num_ctx parameter for a model, based on API type and provider compatibility.

methods.name: wrapOllamaCompatNumCtx
methods.description: Wraps a stream function to add num_ctx parameter to payload options.

methods.name: createOllamaThinkingOffWrapper
methods.description: Wraps a stream function to disable thinking (think=false) for Ollama models.

methods.name: resolveOllamaCompatNumCtx
methods.description: Calculates the number of tokens to use for Ollama models, defaulting to a minimum of 1.

methods.name: isOllamaCloudKimiModelRef
methods.description: Checks if a model ID indicates a Kimi cloud model reference.

methods.name: createConfiguredOllamaCompatStreamWrapper
methods.description: Creates a stream wrapper with Ollama compatibility features, including num_ctx injection and thinking level adjustments.

methods.name: buildOllamaChatRequest
methods.description: Constructs a chat request object for Ollama API from parameters.

methods.name: buildUsageWithNoCost
methods.description: Builds a usage object with zero cost for all token counts.

methods.name: buildStreamAssistantMessage
methods.description: Creates an assistant message object for streaming responses.

methods.name: buildStreamErrorAssistantMessage
methods.description: Creates an error assistant message object for streaming error handling.

methods.name: convertToOllamaMessages
methods.description: Converts generic message objects into Ollama-specific message format.

methods.name: createOllamaStreamFn
methods.description: Creates a stream function to interact with Ollama API, handling request, response, and streaming logic.

methods.name: createConfiguredOllamaStreamFn
methods.description: Creates a configured Ollama stream function with base URL and headers.
